title: Introduced to Jake Barber before he went public

tellings.quote: I met him I think it was like June of 24 or something along those lines.

plain: A guest named Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a government UFO program as a child, says he met a man named Jake Barber before Barber went public with his own claims. Jose tells it as something he took part in and dates it roughly: "I met him I think it was like June of 24 or something along those lines."
